rules: Orbs denote AI movement only, beside a word. Never as decoration and never as a spinner library.
The canvas is presentational and aria-hidden. The adjacent word is the accessible name.
prefers-reduced-motion paints one still frame. The animation can be paused.
Confidence is a coarse word plus an orb, never a percent.
On an existing app, add an orb only beside a status word the screen already renders. Do not invent status or bind new state.

breathing.meaning: Idle. The system is at rest.
